_about: Every check a change must pass, run in this order by `bin/mpdev check`. CI runs the same list (docs/specs/2026-10-10-agent-ready-codebase.md, step 3). {python} is the interpreter running mpdev. Add a check here, not in a script or a workflow, so the CLI, CI and the skills can't drift apart.

checks.about: This machine has what the other checks need.
Knowledge pages resolve their links, are all indexed, and keep section leads under 250 characters.
